name: Admin Project Inline Create Assign Offer
description: The gap the Vastago case exposed: a project created inline from an accounting form picker (crear al vuelo) used to discard the annotated create response, so the operator was never told the client had older records without a project. Now the created event carries the unlinked_* counters and, when the form closes (saved OR cancelled - the project is a record of its own), the PA-51 assign modal opens with the server-fresh backlog; confirming assigns the checked ids and the response rows (cascaded liquid children included) fill the Proyecto cells of the open table without any reload. Since F7 (Aug 2026) the offer also lists the client's DOCUMENTS without a project — cuentas de cobro of any commercial status included, shown by their public number: filling an issued cuenta's missing project is organisational metadata with no other UI write path (the generic document PATCH refuses non-drafts), so this confirmed-list flow and the link_records_single_project command are its only vehicles. document_ids travel with the confirmed plan and unlinked_documents_count joins the per-row backlog counters.
